# ElementBase

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Base class for PDF elements that provides common functionality for margin handling, Y-position tracking, and content width calculation. This reduces code duplication across elements and ensures consistent behavior.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Implements `IElement`, `IMargin`.

## Properties

- [`BreakAllowed`](#breakallowed): Whether this element can be split across page boundaries.
- [`CaptureName`](#capturename): Optional author-supplied name/key surfaced in the layout snapshot.
- [`CaptureType`](#capturetype): Canonical element type name used for the layout snapshot tree.
- [`ContentDirection`](#contentdirection): Inline direction override.
- [`KeepWithNext`](#keepwithnext): Keeps this element with the start of its next sibling in vertical flow.
- [`Margin`](#margin): Margin around this element

### `BreakAllowed`

```csharp
bool BreakAllowed { get; set; }
```

Whether this element can be split across page boundaries. When false, the element is treated as atomic and will be moved to a new page rather than split. If it doesn't fit on a fresh page either, it renders anyway. Default is true.

### `CaptureName`

```csharp
string CaptureName { get; set; }
```

Optional author-supplied name/key surfaced in the layout snapshot. Null by default; a future capture API can populate it.

### `CaptureType`

```csharp
string CaptureType { get; }
```

*read-only*

Canonical element type name used for the layout snapshot tree. Defaults to the runtime type name; subclasses may override for a stable spec name.

### `ContentDirection`

```csharp
ContentDirection? ContentDirection { get; set; }
```

Inline direction override. Null inherits the enclosing direction.

### `KeepWithNext`

```csharp
bool KeepWithNext { get; set; }
```

Keeps this element with the start of its next sibling in vertical flow.

### `Margin`

```csharp
Thickness Margin { get; set; }
```

Margin around this element
